profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech
profile.summary:
I am a self-motivated and enthusiastic engineer with a Masters of Science in Software Engineering from San Jose State University. 

Currently, I am working as a Staff Software Engineer at Walmart. Driving improvements to machine learning models on Walmart's advertising platform, focusing on ranking and relevance of sponsored products. Also implemented, enhanced and maintained features for site facing service which aggregates millions of data daily.

As a part of my professional experience, Worked as Data Engineer at iPass Inc. to implement big data knowledge by working on batch processing on terabytes of data, deriving various insights from the iPass's data using Scala and Spark.

Developed many different projects in Spark, Java and full stack web applications implementing various Software Engineering methods like agile, scrum, XP values, design patterns and MVC architecture.

My area of interest includes Data Engineering and Machine Learning Engineering

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of Walmart's Advertisement tech team, developed sponsored product ranking and relevance systems, and worked on advertiser bid optimization to increase revenue. Mentored senior and junior data science engineers, translating product requirements into ML solutions and managing project execution.
Provided expert Spark support for pipeline optimization and cost reduction. I designed an automated Spark job profiling mechanism to identify bottlenecks and improve execution efficiency. Building on this, I designed a closed-loop LLM optimization agent for Spark that refines configurations using profiling feedback to drive runtime reductions and cost savings across daily workloads. To ground recommendations, I built a hybrid RAG pipeline using historical job data and Spark documentation, alongside an LLM-based evaluation framework with structured scoring to cut manual tuning effort.
Designed feature generation pipelines on GCP orchestrated via Airflow. I standardized the ML lifecycle by productionizing workflows to ensure consistent, reproducible pipelines. Led a data freshness initiative here as well, transitioning data availability from daily to hourly for terabyte-scale pipelines and optimizing PySpark and Hive architectures to support massive increases in entity volume.
Orchestrated the shift from Hive tables to a centralized feature store, simplifying feature engineering and reducing resource needs for feature serving. As part of this, I architected a scalable Feature Store and redesigned the FEAST SDK to heavily reduce retrieval latency for training data generation, accelerating model iteration cycles for ranking and relevance teams.
Engineered a feature cataloging solution to improve feature reuse across teams, and designed an Ads-wide data quality framework with automated anomaly detection and Grafana observability to ensure 24/7 data integrity.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of Walmart eCommerce customer tech team, I worked on designing highly scalable and reliable features on the platform to aggregate billions of events daily and serve search page with aggregated data.
Engineered data insights platform to provide data snapshots, identify trends for Walmart buybox and analyze data to improve operational excellence.
Reduced data debugging time by architecting and implementing a real-time data auditing platform
Created library for throttling and managing inbound events to optimize systems performance under heavy loads.
Enhanced monitoring platform by implementing different metrics and alerts which helped the team to monitor systems at granular level and implemented logging library to debug issues faster

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Working in Customer tech team responsible for serving data to Walmart.com and Grocery.walmart.com to enable better item discoverability on the websites.
Developed ETL jobs using Spark, SQL and Kafka to process and generate aggregated data to be served on search page
Enhanced the logging system to develop different metrics which helped the team to speed up debugging issue and also monitoring issue at granular level.
Streamlined item page content delivery by enhancing and supporting that modularized and structured catalog data thereby improving customer experience.
Drove infrastructure modernization by migrating services to Kubernetes, resulting in substantial cost savings, increased service availability, and rapid scalability.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Built high-volume real-time data processing framework and data driven platform for analyzing WIFI data using Spark, Kafka and S3.
Optimized and maintained data access layer performance by 23% using Cassandra queries in Spring boot framework.
Developed jobs and libraries in scala with code coverage of more than 70% to build more robust data processing platform.
Performed in-depth analysis of the client WIFI connectivity data obtained by the querying to S3 data store and creating solutions to support decision making for client team.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Engineering · Apache Spark · Scala · Java · Cassandra

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern - Big Data Visualization
positions.description:
Utilized the data from different platform collectors using Kafka streams and automated the interpretation of the data using batch and streaming jobs to draw conclusion for variety of solutions.
Developed Technical Assistance Request framework using Spring and bootstrap which can be plugged into different products and can be used by clients to report issues and bugs in the system.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed 3D UI for installation, orchestration and big-data analysis of network virtualization product using three.js, NATS, Spring, gulp, gradle, AngularJS,  and Docker.

positions.title: Global Operations & Quality Engineering Tools Intern
positions.description: Designing and developing a system that recommends appropriate steps to take as a result of a customer request to return devices(semiconducting chips) on the basis of structured and unstructured inputs

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered as event coordinator at a successful event "Resume Critique workshop" in which professionals of silicon valley came to SJSU campus and guided students to achieve success in getting internship and full time jobs.

Volunteered in event called "Suswagatam" organized by HinduYUVA SJSU. The event focusses on helping out new incoming SJSU international students by providing them free pickups from airports and free temporary accommodation for 7-10 days.

projects.title: Hackerrank Question Recommendation System
projects.description:
Demonstrated Data mining knowledge on real life question recommendation problem for the most widely used hiring platform - HackerRank.
Devised a website built in Django framework of Python which analyzes dataset with more than 28000 entries stored in PostgreSQL.
Predicted difficulty of question by implementing Naive Bayes theorem with the accuracy of 45.6%.
Generated dynamic nvd3 graphs of the similarities and associations found between different parameters after implementing KNN and Apriori algorithm.
Tools/Technologies used: Sublime text, PostgreSQL, Angular nvd3 graphs, Python, Django Framework, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap

projects.title: Cosmy Marketplace
projects.description:
Integrated the website of all the group members in a Single website  which can be considered as marketplace for the five websites.User can rate/review the products or services from any of the five websites.
The website tracks the events of the user also his/her recently and most visited websites. 
A user's session can also be maintained via passport login.
Used MySql,Bootstrap,PHP,Curl, HTML 5.0 and CSS 3.0
